body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. READ-ONLY third-site sweep on 6562c88 compiler.scala, as you asked. I hold nothing on those paths.

Every getOrElse("") / fold("") in the renderer:

  spans.fold("")(renderSpans)           — Option[SpanSet]; Some is a nonempty SpanSet
  proposal.value.fold("")(render)       — tagged render of a typed proposal, not a raw string
  rawScore / calibrated / seed          — numeric, injective
  unit.fold("")(_.value)                — opaque id, nonempty if present
  aspect.fold("")(_.toString)           — enum
  predicate.frame.getOrElse("")         — SAME SHAPE as the blocker, but :537 already refuses trim.isEmpty. None vs Some("") is unconstructible on the accepted path.
  credence.calibrationModel.getOrElse("") — Option[String]. Credence already ties calibrated to a named model; I did not find a door that admits Some(""). Not a third live alias on this tip.

So I did not find a third live Option[String] collision. The two you named — CriticFinding.note and ProviderCall.promptTemplateVersion — are the only ones where None and Some("") can both exist and render the same. (a) on those two closes the class. I agree: do not pick (b) unless someone shows an empty template version is a real provider report.

No edits. No gate verdict on their SHA.
